completedFeatures.notes: Added SQLite support with database abstraction layer, migrated all PostgreSQL stored procedures to Python query classes
Added Orange Plot, Balance Chart, Custody Chart visualizations, btc_viz CLI, and PDF report generation
Dead code removal, wallet_imports.py extraction, performance fixes
CLI import system with registry, validation, 8 exchange parsers (Coinbase, Kraken, Strike, River, Swan, Cash App, Gemini, Native), --dry-run and --withdraw-to support
Wallet import parsers (Ledger Live, Trezor Suite, Sparrow, Coldcard) integrated into CLI import system with --wallet-name support
Added FIAT_CURRENCIES constant and is_fiat() helper, updated all exchange parsers (Kraken, Swan, River, Gemini, Coinbase Pro) to handle fiat deposits/withdrawals
Modernized export_tx with argparse, added wallet/date filtering, --wallets for multiple wallets, dry-run preview, Spend transaction type support, PostgreSQL compatibility

Refactored cryptoAccounts.py from 918-line monolithic class into 4 specialized query classes (TransactionQuery, LedgerWriter, CapitalGainCalculator, WalletQuery) using Query Object pattern with dependency injection. 54% reduction in main class size, 1,264 lines of new tests, zero regressions.
